methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 external and chamber food vacuum sealers. Two requested SKUs do not exist and were substituted with notes: 'Wevac CV6' (Wevac's chamber lineup is CV10 / CV12 / CV12 Turbo only -> CV10 substituted) and 'Potane VS5520' (Potane's active Precision Pro SKU is VS5736 -> substituted). All prices and headline specs independently re-verified June 2026 against manufacturer pages (anovaculinary.com, nesco.com, avidarmor.com, inkbird.com, potane.com, wevactech.com, foodsaver.com) and reputable retailers/reviews. Corrections applied this pass: FoodSaver VS3150 pulse_function false->true (FoodSaver lists a pulse setting) and accessory_port true->null (model uses a retractable handheld sealer, no confirmed hose port); FoodSaver FM2000 built_in_cutter and bag_roll_storage null->false (the FM2100 ADDS these over the FM2000 per FoodSaver, so FM2000 lacks both); Wevac CV10 accessory_port false->null (manufacturer states an external-vacuum accessory hose/port exists, an independent review says it lacks one - disputed); Bonsenkitchen VS3802 and Mueller MV-1100 priceUsd set to null (no current published US retail price verifiable; both now sell mainly on secondary market); Potane VS5736 priceNote corrected ($179.99 MSRP, $149.99 current, not $149.99 MSRP). seal_width_in = max compatible bag width in inches unless an exact sealing-bar dimension was stated. boolean true = feature present; null = could not corroborate. priceUsd = lowest verified US MSRP or typical current retail. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: FoodSaver VS3150 Multi-Use Vacuum Sealing System
products.priceNote: Current retail $214 at Walmart; MSRP not separately published
products.provenance: Price $214 confirmed via Walmart listing. FoodSaver's own feature copy for the VS3150 lists pulse, marinate, moist and dry settings plus roll storage with a built-in cutter bar (dry/moist true, cutter true, roll storage true, pulse true - draft's pulse_function:false was WRONG). Accessory_port set null: the multi-use design uses a retractable handheld sealer rather than a confirmed hose/canister port. Exact seal-bar width not published by FoodSaver.

products.name: FoodSaver FM2000 Vacuum Sealing System
products.provenance: Price $79.97 confirmed at Home Depot. Dry-only (no Moist mode) confirmed. built_in_cutter and bag_roll_storage corrected null->false: FoodSaver/retailer comparisons state the FM2100 ADDS integrated roll storage and a cutter bar over the FM2000, so the FM2000 lacks both. Accessory port (hose) included/confirmed. Seal-bar width not published. Comes with an 11in x 10ft roll and accessory hose.

Pulse feature confirmed via buyer's guide. Accessory port confirmed: VS0150 accepts the FoodSaver accessory hose (part 176873000000) for canisters/containers. Exact seal-bar width not published.
